title: Vela imported-mesh qualification report v1 (contract C2)
description: Report written by the WP2 mesh importer next to mesh.json and doping.csv when a Sentaurus TDR or DF-ISE grid is converted for vela device. It records what the mesh is (counts, materials, contacts, angles, units) so that the pre-flight gates (plan section 7, step 5) and the deck emitter can decide without re-reading the mesh. It never contains solver decisions other than the recommended node-volume policy.

grid_file.description: File{Grid} as resolved by the parser (basename, relative to the cmd directory).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the grid file bytes (for DF-ISE: the .grd file).

companion_file.description: DF-ISE only: the .dat file that supplied the doping fields.

importer.description: Tool and version that produced the conversion, e.g. sentaurus_import <commit> or dfise_reader v1.

dimension.description: Spatial dimension of the source grid. vela device accepts 2 only (E402 otherwise).

declared.description: Unit attribute found in the file (TDR) or the DF-ISE convention 'um'; null when absent.

applied_scale_to_um.description: Factor applied to the stored coordinates to obtain micrometres in mesh.json.

count.description: Elements written to mesh.json (triangles after any conversion).

by_kind.description: Element kinds found in the source grid before conversion.

converted_quadrilaterals.description: Number of quadrilaterals split into two triangles by the deterministic diagonal rule documented by WP2; 0 when the importer rejects quadrilaterals instead.

material.description: Vela material name after the importer's mapping (Silicon -> Si, Oxide -> SiO2); unmapped names are passed through verbatim.

source_material.description: Material name as stored in the grid when it differs from 'material'.

materials.description: Distinct Vela material names in region order of first appearance.

columns.description: Column names written to doping.csv; the contract fixes them to node_id, donors_cm3, acceptors_cm3.

source_fields.description: Grid datasets consumed (e.g. DonorConcentration, AcceptorConcentration, DopingConcentration).

net_only.description: True when only the net DopingConcentration was available and donors/acceptors were split by sign.

triangles_only.description: True when the source grid had no non-triangle 2-D elements (before conversion).

coordinates_plausible.description: Bounding box extent within 1e-3 .. 1e4 um in every direction (plan section 7 step 5).

recommended_node_volume_policy.description: barycentric for every imported Sentaurus mesh (plan section 7); mixed_voronoi only when non_obtuse is true and a sidecar asks for it.

allow_obtuse.description: Always true for imported meshes: obtuse triangles are reported, not rejected.

electrodes_checked.description: Filled by the orchestrator at gate 5: electrode names from the IR and whether each one matched a contact.
